scope: Four Korean originals and all seven new language editions per topic. Compared headings, paragraphs, table cells, prompts, source references and diagram labels.
method: Parallel AI translation and comparison with the Korean originals. Additional AI review of all four English editions and a sample of French and Spanish editions. limits: No new upstream fact audit or human or native-speaker language review.
